authority: review/AUTO_DECISION_SCOPE.md (Fable claude-fable-5-1, owner-delegated); frozen BEFORE any study score or candidate training

noise_reference.rule: sigma_hat = max over matched epochs (3,4, and 5 if both cool5 COMPLETE) of |A1 s2026 - A1 s2027| full-VS macro MRR@20; fallback 0.002

probes.semantics: code/feature_view.py apply_probe; unavailable values = real pipeline transform of the sentinel; duplicates move together; verified against real rows (probe_runner.encoding_check) before scoring
probes.p8_cell_rule: modal (local_weekday_idx, daypart_idx) over TRAIN feature rows (stream_fit.py), instant = local band midpoint

screen.label: EXPLORATORY warm-start adaptation, not a from-scratch ablation
screen.warm_start: pinned baseline weights, strict load; fresh AdamW in every arm

manifest.method: numpy default_rng(20260927).choice(40180608, 5000000, replace=False); order = data order

lr.schedule: linear warmup then cosine to 1e-5 at the final update

screen.recipe: AdamW(0.9,0.999) eps 1e-8, WD 1e-5 on matrices, grad clip 1.0, dropout 0.2, CE (no smoothing), output recentering each step, TF32 training, strict FP32 eval

C1_D3.definition: code/feature_view.py d3_features: known tokens (>=3) only, retained window, positions <= t; log1p(.)/log(50)
C1_D3.definition_clarified_2026-09-25_review_C: d3_known_distinct_ratio = (# distinct KNOWN tokens at window positions <= t) / (t+1), where the denominator counts EVERY real position <= t including OOV/MISSING ones; bounded (0,1], causal. Text clarification of the existing definition before any training (Fable Review C, choice 4).
C1_D3.entry: appended to event_numeric_features -> numflag_proj input columns 19..23, zero-initialised

screen.C2: only if gate 2(a) names a probe: that probe's coherent-absence transform as a permanent adapter (train + eval)

pair.status: registered, implemented only if gate 2(b) yields a finalist (then a correction-only Fable review of the pair code)
pair.preferred: CONTROL_REUSE iff the campaign A1 s2026 base+cool5 realised schedule equals the frozen 5-epoch schedule, the trainer is the byte-identical snapshot, and a 20k-update replay matches the logged loss
pair.otherwise: sequential from-scratch control first (needs >= 11.9 GiB free), concurrent only if >= 13.8 GiB
pair.schedule: U=156,956; warmup 2,000 to 1e-3; peak epoch 1; cosine to 1e-4 epoch 2; floor epochs 3-4; epoch-5 cooldown 1e-6+(1e-4-1e-6)(1-sqrt(t)); full VS at 3,4,5
pair.acceptance: same as gate 2(b) on full VS (per-arm best of e3/e4/e5), R@20 guard 0.001, candidate >= pinned incumbent
pair.disk: one atomic latest.pt (no previous.pt for study runs) + epoch 3/4/5 weights; optimizer file deleted after completion and hashing

hygiene_deliverable.LEAN_FOLD: drop 9 exact duplicate channels + 6 dead flags, M1 valid-only refit + re-zero by mask (recorded clip bounds kept so the fold is exact), folded weights; parity on the cohort; no training
